description: Election Commission - Declare that Dehigama Sumangala Thero as a member of the Harispattuwa Pradehiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Harispattuwa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a member who vacated their seat due to non-attendance of meetings, including the nomination process by a political party and the formal declaration of the newly elected member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under election-related matters and electoral processes.
